changelog:
- feat: Add option to pause slideshow and trailers during external media playback (Cast / MPV Shim)
- feat: Add option to randomize background images when multiple are available
description: ▶ Feature-rich Media Bar fork that brings your home screen to life. ★ 100% Web UI control. ★ Backdrops: Cinematic full-width videos (YouTube/Local) with SponsorBlock (skip intros/outros (only YT Trailer)) and smart 'local-first' preference. ★ Dynamic Content: Display Playlists, Collections (Boxsets), or Seasonal holiday items. Sort by Random, Year, or Premiere Date with Parental Rating & Release Year filters. ★ Customization: Customizable overlays (branding/messages), pagination (dots/counter), and client-side settings to allow per-device overrides. ★ Advanced: Many settings for individual configuration. ⚠ Note: Requires 'file-transformation' plugin if write permissions are restricted.
name: Media Bar Enhanced
overview: Transforms your Jellyfin home screen with an immersive, fully configurable media slideshow featuring video backdrops.
